KBS World Radio FAQ

What frequency is KBS World Radio on?
In the A-26 season KBS World Radio is scheduled on 23 shortwave frequencies, including 3955, 6090, 6095, 6145, 6155, 7215 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 15770 kHz (7 pm – 7:30 pm Eastern). For Europe: 6145 kHz (8 pm – 9 pm UTC+1).

Can I hear KBS World Radio in the USA?
Yes. KBS World Radio is beamed at North America this season on 15575, 15770 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 15770 kHz (7 pm – 7:30 pm Eastern).

Does KBS World Radio broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 9515 kHz at 15:00–17:00 UTC to Europe; 9570 kHz at 10:00–11:00 UTC to South America; 9570 kHz at 13:00–14:00 UTC to SE Asia; 9630 kHz at 14:00–16:00 UTC to South Asia; 9640 kHz at 16:00–17:00 UTC to SE Asia; plus 6 more.

Is KBS World Radio on the air right now?
As of Friday, September 25, 2026, 10:11 UTC, KBS World Radio is scheduled to be broadcasting on 9570 kHz to South America. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
